answer_1.quote: Question generation (QG) is a hot research topic that aims to create valid and fluent questions ...

answer_2.quote: We adopted three standard evaluation metrics in the QG task, including BLEU-4, METEOR, and ROUGE-L ...

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 100 cases from the test set and generated questions for each test case by all the evaluated methods. We then invited eight students to give the binary rating on each question independently. The rating was in terms of three metrics, including valid syntax, relevance to input textual sentences, and logical rationality to the answer.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters (eight students) were asked to rate each generated question binary based on valid syntax, relevance to the input text, and logical rationality to the answer.
